Dear Mike,

I am not quite sure if the last post was actually saved, wherefore I write a second one...

First of all thank you very much for providing the community with such a great package!

I would like to ask, if you are planning to release an updated version of the package that gives reliable results for the ezPerm function. Secondly, I would like to know what function you recommend for following-up on significant main effects.

Best,
Christine

messages.body_plain:
Hi

I would like to analyse a Randomized complete block design.

4 blocks, 4 level of treatment represented in each block, and 3 sub replicates (variable Rep holds the number of the subreplicate 1, 2 or 3 in each T xB combination

that aov formula gives the correct F test

 aov (DV ~ Treatment + Block + Error(Treatment:Block))

but I cannot find the syntax to get equivalent results with ezANOVA

I tried
ezANOVA(...
        dv=DV,
        wid=Rep,
        within=Rep,
        between=.(Treatment, Block)
)

and get the following error
 contrasts can be applied only to factors with 2 or more levels

also I get this warning

The column supplied as the wid variable contains non-unique values across levels of the supplied between-Ss variables. Automatically fixing this by generating unique wid labels.

but the doc says wid should be unique within each case only which is the case for variable Rep

thanks for any advice
